name: United Reformed Church (UK)

citations.excerpt: The union between the Congregational Church in England and Wales, and the Presbyterian Church of England took place in 1972.

facts.value: Formed in 1972 by a union of the Congregational Church in England and Wales with the Presbyterian Church of England, later joined by Churches of Christ (1981) and the Congregational Union of Scotland (2000).

citations.excerpt: In 1981 the Reformed Association of Churches of Christ was united with the United Reformed Church and in 2000 the Congregational Union of Scotland united with the United Reformed Church.
The union between the Congregational Church in England and Wales, and the Presbyterian Church of England took place in 1972.

facts.value_before_verify: A union of English and Welsh Congregationalists with English Presbyterians, later joined by Churches of Christ (1981) and the Congregational Union of Scotland (2000).
